name: One-way rotary-motion qualifier
summary: A rotary-motion qualifier identifies movement or torque in one direction of rotation.
description: A rotary-motion qualifier identifies movement or torque in one direction of rotation. A rotary indication records the direction assigned to a mechanical movement. Its viewpoint matters when the mechanism and its control circuit are shown in separate drawings.
Use a stated viewing reference where rotation direction is significant. The arrow does not substitute for actual machine terminals, wiring or a phase-sequence specification.
readingNotes: Relate the direction to the described mechanism and viewing convention.
An arrow direction is not a complete motor phase-sequence or rotation instruction.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Relate the direction to the described mechanism and viewing convention.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: An arrow direction is not a complete motor phase-sequence or rotation instruction.
